scenes.text: It's ten at night. Your invoices are in one place, your receipts are in another, and VAT is due on Friday.
Meet Nexus Accounting. All of your business finances, connected in one place.
Create a professional invoice in under a minute. Send it by email or WhatsApp, and see the moment your customer pays.
Nexus brings in your bank transactions and matches them to your invoices and bills. Reconciling becomes a quick check, not a lost weekend.
Snap a photo of a receipt. Nexus reads the supplier, the amount and the VAT, and files it for you.
When your VAT period ends, the return is already worked out, and every figure links back to the invoice or receipt behind it.
And one dashboard shows what matters most: cash in the bank, who owes you money, and what's due next.
Nexus Accounting. Less admin, more business. Start your free trial today.
